idea.name: Liquidation pallet resale
idea.one_liner: Buy liquidation and return pallets, sort and price the goods, then resell individual items online for a margin.
idea.customer: Consumers shopping for discounted household goods and other items online
idea.offer: Individual goods recovered from liquidation and return pallets
idea.revenue_model: Buy pallets at a bulk cost and resell usable items individually through online marketplaces, allowing for fees, discounts and unsellable goods.

acquisition_channels.details: Some items were already listed on eBay; he planned to sell a shoe cabinet on Facebook Marketplace and intended to sell the remaining items.

ideas.delivery: The host collects pallets from a liquidation warehouse by truck and trailer, unloads and stores them in his garage, then opens, checks, researches and prices the goods. He plans to list usable items online and ship some; he set aside damaged candles for a possible garage sale and discarded the rest.

prices: 50% to 60% of estimated value as a selling price
